newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-VITOR BAIA OUT INJURED 'AT LEAST TWO MONTHS'.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VITOR BAIA OUT INJURED 'AT LEAST TWO MONTHS'.

text.p: Barcelona's Portugal goalkeeper Vitor Baia will be out injured for at least two months, the Spanish team's doctor Fernando Banos said on Tuesday.
Vitor Baia suffered damage to a left knee tendon during training a week ago and was due to have an operation on Tuesday.
"He could be out for two to three months depending on how quickly he recuperates," Banos said.
The injury means Vitor Baia will miss Portugal's vital World Cup qualifier against Germany on September 6 and will be fighting to get fit in time to play against Northern Ireland on October 11.
